verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs say you can add MCP servers such as Linear, Notion, or an internal service to an agent's config, and Omnara discovers their tools [omnara-docs-17]. The changelog repeats that MCP servers connect agents to your services and data [omnara-docs-5]. Agents are configured in YAML, so plugging a server in is simply part of the config [omnara-docs-1]. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that MCP tool use works, and documentation of transport, auth and tool-filtering details.
